chunks: Their falling place is on this side of the river. By Allāh, not even ten of them will survive while from your side not even ten will be killed.

key_terms.النُّطْفَةِ: Nutfah (a bridge or ford near Nahrawan)
key_terms.مَصَارِعُهُمْ: Their falling places / places of defeat

ai.seo_question: What was the prediction made by Imam Ali regarding the Battle of Nahrawan?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) delivers this concise prophecy during the Battle of Nahrawan, highlighting the strategic precision of the Muslim forces as the Kharijites are slain before fully crossing the bridge of Nutfah. The specific mention of 'ten' martyrs underscores the relative lightness of the Muslim casualties compared to the enemy, a detail that Shia scholars often cite to demonstrate the divine favor and tactical superiority of Imam Ali’s leadership in this decisive conflict.
